# skill: upkeep
saved: installer seed
When: the MEMORY UPKEEP job fires, or memory feels stale. Steps: 1) TOOL recall each section (in:fact, in:pref, in:lesson) to review what is there. 2) TOOL forget the stale, duplicated, or superseded lines. 3) TOOL remember merged replacements with [section] tags. Pitfalls: never forget a line you have not read back; keep BRAIN.md under ~2000 chars; lessons outrank facts, prefs outrank guesses.
